scope: Independent source pitch, score-structure and exported PCM checks; no subjective listening approval.
pitchMethod: Three onset-relative 16384-frame windows (80/160/280ms); unconstrained 65--4000Hz YIN-style first trough <0.12, quadratic period refinement; median MIDI and cents error. Guitar correction checked against all score event instances, then independently Fourier-resampled source measured with matching time-scaled windows. Additionally the exact current sample_for function is AST-extracted and executed in an isolated context (no main/download/output mutation), and its actual 44.1kHz filtered, corrected sample and cache reuse are checked. Ensemble/vibrato estimates remain natural and uncorrected.
correctedOctaveConvention: VSCO labels C4 at sounding MIDI72, one octave above scientific C4=MIDI60; actual source bases verified. Meta source bases use scientific convention.

scoreReview.form: A / A-prime / contrast / varied return, 8 bars each
scoreReview.secondaryDominants: Bar14 E7 B-G#-F#-E (9th included) resolves to bar15 Am7; bar24 G7 leads to bar25 Cmaj7.
scoreReview.thematicShape: Four-note descending opening; upward answer; repeated/varied A; middle woodwind transfer; related return.
scoreReview.articulation: Guitar 2ms sin-squared attack, 180ms cos-squared tail; small overlaps between released tails are intentional. Do not claim globally monophonic PCM.
scoreReview.noReferenceTranscription: Composition source contains authored notes and fixed arrangement; this review did not compare a reference transcription or assess perceptual similarity.

pcmReview.loopInterpretation: The only long near-silent region is a short phrase-ending breath. No long artificial loop gap.

limitations: No subjective listening was performed; pitch/score/PCM metrics cannot establish pleasantness, naturalism or fidelity to reference performance.
Sample-layer performance is not a live ensemble recording.
Pitch estimates include recorded vibrato and limited sample windows.
The processed single-note checks verify both an independent resampling and the exact current renderer sample function, rather than isolating notes from the polyphonic exported mix.
